# Draft:The Battle of The Somalian River (fantasy)

The Battle of the Somalian River (fantasy)
The Battle of the Somalian River was a catastrophic battle that took place in the Somalian River between the Somali forces and the Monegasque forces.
Some well known soldiers, such as Lieutenant Sir Nelson and General Quadinaros, fought in the battle. Nelson fought for the meany mackral division of the Monegasque forces and General Quadinaros was in charge of the Somali forces.
In English, the name is not grammatically correct, this is because General Quadinaros didn’t speak English well.
Weaponry
Many weapons were used in this battle, both old and new. Old weapons included flails, mancatchers, khopesh and zhua. Modern weapons included Dardick revolvers, Project Pigeon missiles, vomit guns and railguns.
Divisions
The Monegasque forces had a few divisions, they included the Meany Mackrals, a Special Forces division that specialises underwater, sinks ships and uses grapple guns to pull people into the water. Lieutenant Sir Nelson led this division. The spelling of that word may sound weird but that was due to the fact that the division was created by Darth Jar Jar Binks who did not have very good spelling. Another division was the Creepy Clingfishes. This underwater division has suction cups on their limbs and uses it to climb up ships. They have helmets that can detect what they’re thinking and have wires that connect to a gun attached to their suit on their back so they can shoot people once they climb aboard. This division was led by Darth Jar Jar Binks who accidentally killed the rest of the division when showing off his ability to use the Force. Some divisions in the Somali Forces include the Cheaty Cheetahs who were the fastest in all of East Africa. They wielded Nayar Temple Swords and foil lightsabers which would slice enemies as they ran by.
